verdict.rationale: Authy is a consumer authenticator app, so programmatic vault management is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no documented API for creating or updating a user's vault entries. The only documented programmatic surface is the Authy API/SDK, which lets developers integrate 2FA into their own apps; that is adjacent and does not let an agent seed TOTP secrets into a user's vault. That API is also closed to new customers, and adding secrets is documented only as manual QR-code capture in the app.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
